scope: Club draft UX and source-bound embedding of existing DJ deck; no replacement deck implementation
changes: One visible Club navigation: Dancefloor, DJ deck, LJ light, MC guide and LDV room
Redundant Dancefloor-enter CTA and disabled upcoming-deck slot removed
DJ deck is loaded lazily as one embedded original source instance per Jukebox tab
Existing Turntable/Grammophon/Digital, N-AM/L-VM/G-PM mixer and 16x3 readout remain owned by original source
Deck, Family and LDV routes share Club shell and explicit return paths
Family selection, layout, camera and local reading history held across route changes

If file-origin access/API is unavailable, iframe is removed so no hidden timer remains; next load explicitly reports restart and discarded frame-local state
Reload button explicitly declares local deck-stand discard; original opens separately on demand
not_implemented: No shared source state or clock
No N-AM/L-VM/G-PM mixture applied to Family geometry or LDV visual
No automatic navigation receipt or scientific Return
No control of independent source tabs, source games or external instruments
